evals_reused_note: Origin ships 4 real evals (evals/evals.json). Reused as the basis for all 4 task-success cases here, adapted only in the two places noted below.
live_dependency_note: This skill's whole value proposition is fetching REAL, current Bilibili engagement numbers rather than estimating them, which is fundamentally in tension with a fixed, reproducible benchmark corpus. Resolution: none of the origin author's own grading criteria hardcode a specific golden number in the first place — every expectation is process-based ('used the fetch script, not a guess', 'included the fetched_at timestamp', 'did not fabricate a transcript when none exists'), which stays gradeable even though the underlying live numbers legitimately differ between benchmark reruns. Kept as a genuine live call rather than mocked with a fixture server, because building and maintaining a mock Bilibili API stand-in would itself be a nontrivial harness component for one corpus entry, and would stop testing the thing this skill is actually for (real API integration correctness). Flagged live=true so Phase 3's harness caps rep count against this entry specifically (avoid hammering a real third-party API at full benchmark scale) rather than treating it identically to the 15 fully offline entries.
